content.summary: Implemented sanitized DEBUG request logging for Opus bad request diagnostics.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: A DEBUG log entry emitted before streamText includes providerID, modelID, sessionID, agent name, variant key, and maxOutputTokens.
Log payload includes thinking summary (effort + budget) and message/tool counts without prompt text, file contents, or auth headers.
Variant selection is logged without changing merge order; missing variants log as null.
Logging is gated by DEBUG level so INFO output remains unchanged.

data.notes: Added buildRequestLog helper and DEBUG instrumentation before streamText; reused active tool keys for log counts.
